admission.justification: Mistaking a foreign listener for the sandbox, or selecting another port around it, can displace a live service; process ownership and socket enumeration enforce refusal across three files.

applicability: The canonical PNT sandbox start command and its reserved listen ports.
conditions: The selected sandbox command is running on Linux with readable process or source observations; otherwise its named refusal applies.
exclusions: Private evidence drivers can explicitly construct another port layout; automatic port selection is excluded.
statement: Public sandbox build/check/start/stop accept explicitly chosen host/dashboard ports, retaining defaults6820/9797 and the same ownership/safety refusals without automatic port selection. The named tooling has one public renderer; actual product roots/runtime are admitted separately.
